blocks_element.repere: Titre H2 · The Science Behind the Relief.
Paragraphe · Buckley works by addressing cat allergen
blocks_element.text: Buckley works by addressing cat allergens at the source. Cats produce the main allergen, Fel d 1, in their saliva. When they groom, that allergen spreads onto their fur and throughout your home.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Buckley contains a natural protein found
blocks_element.text: Buckley contains a natural protein found in eggs called IgY. When your cat eats it, IgY binds to Fel d 1 in the mouth and helps make it inactive — so less allergen is spread during grooming.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · The Key Ingredient: IgY Technology
Paragraphe · Our formula relies on a specific protein
blocks_element.text: Our formula relies on a specific protein derived from eggs that naturally binds to Fel d 1. This is not a synthetic drug; it is a bio-functional food ingredient that targets the allergen structure directly.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · A Physical, Not Chemical Reaction
Paragraphe · Unlike antihistamines that alter body fu
blocks_element.text: Unlike antihistamines that alter body function, Buckley works on contact in the mouth. It simply coats and neutralizes the protein in the saliva, leaving your cat’s natural biology completely untouched.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · While the neutralization happens immedia
blocks_element.text: While the neutralization happens immediately upon eating, reducing the existing allergen load in your home takes time. Most cat owners report a noticeable difference in allergy symptoms after 30 days of consistent daily use.

blocks_element.text: Because Buckley is just a natural egg powder with no additives, it is safe for cats on prescription diets (e.g., urinary or kidney support) and won't interfere with other medications.
